timers.name: HIIT circuit
timers.description: 3 rounds of squats, push-ups and burpees (40 s on, 20 s rest), with warm-up and cool-down.

intervals.name: Warm up
intervals.comment: Easy pace: jumping jacks, arm circles, bodyweight squats.

intervals.name: Squats
intervals.comment: Hips back, chest up, knees track over toes.

intervals.name: Push-ups
intervals.comment: Body in a straight line, elbows at about 45°.

intervals.name: Burpees
intervals.comment: Chest to the floor, then jump and clap overhead.

intervals.name: Cool down
intervals.comment: Walk, then easy stretches for legs and chest.

timers.name: Plank x3
timers.description: Three 1-minute planks with 30 s rest. Core endurance.

intervals.name: Plank
intervals.comment: Elbows under shoulders, squeeze glutes, don't let the hips sag.

timers.name: Mobility #A: Hamstrings, adductors and back
timers.description: Stretch at ~6/10, never into sharp pain. Good after a lower-body day; avoid before heavy squats or deadlifts.

intervals.name: Cat-cow
intervals.comment: Slow, segment by segment.

intervals.name: Hamstring strap – left
intervals.comment: Hold 20 s → press 5 s at ~30% → relax deeper. 3 rounds.

intervals.name: Hamstring strap – right
intervals.comment: Hold 20 s → press 5 s at ~30% → relax deeper. 3 rounds.

intervals.name: Standing forward fold
intervals.comment: Knees bent, chest on thighs, slowly straighten. Hinge from the hips.

intervals.name: Seated straddle (pancake)
intervals.comment: Long spine, lean from the hips, hands on the floor or a block.

intervals.name: Child's pose
intervals.comment: Hips to heels, arms long, breathe into the back.

intervals.name: Thread the needle – left
intervals.comment: Slide the arm under, shoulder and ear to the floor.

intervals.name: Thread the needle – right
intervals.comment: Slide the arm under, shoulder and ear to the floor.

intervals.name: Thoracic open book – left
intervals.comment: Knees stacked, rotate the top arm open.

intervals.name: Thoracic open book – right
intervals.comment: Knees stacked, rotate the top arm open.

intervals.name: Chin tucks (10 slow reps)
intervals.comment: Glide the head back, keep eyes level.

intervals.name: Upper trap stretch – left
intervals.comment: Ear to shoulder, opposite hand reaching down.

intervals.name: Upper trap stretch – right
intervals.comment: Ear to shoulder, opposite hand reaching down.

intervals.name: Levator stretch – left
intervals.comment: Nose toward armpit.

intervals.name: Levator stretch – right
intervals.comment: Nose toward armpit.

timers.name: Mobility #B: Hips, split and shoulders
timers.description: Hip rotation, front-split and shoulder mobility, plus neck. Stretch at ~6/10, never into sharp pain.

intervals.name: 90/90 hip switches
intervals.comment: Rotate side to side, lean over the front shin at the end.

intervals.name: Frog stretch
intervals.comment: Knees wide, shins parallel, rock then hold.

intervals.name: Couch stretch – left
intervals.comment: Squeeze the glute of the back leg.

intervals.name: Couch stretch – right
intervals.comment: Squeeze the glute of the back leg.

intervals.name: Half split ↔ lunge rocking – left
intervals.comment: Rock between half split and lunge.

intervals.name: Front split hold – left
intervals.comment: Settle into the split, no bouncing.

intervals.name: Half split ↔ lunge rocking – right
intervals.comment: Rock between half split and lunge.

intervals.name: Front split hold – right
intervals.comment: Settle into the split, no bouncing.

intervals.name: Deep squat hold
intervals.comment: Elbows push knees out, heels down (plate under heels if needed).

intervals.name: Wall slides (10 reps)
intervals.comment: Back and arms against the wall.

intervals.name: Pass-throughs (10 reps)
intervals.comment: Band or stick, arms straight.

intervals.name: Doorway pec stretch – left
intervals.comment: Forearm on the frame, step through until you feel the chest.

intervals.name: Doorway pec stretch – right
intervals.comment: Forearm on the frame, step through until you feel the chest.

intervals.name: Chin tucks (10 slow reps)
intervals.comment: Glide the head back, keep eyes level.

intervals.name: Upper trap stretch – left
intervals.comment: Ear to shoulder, opposite hand reaching down.

intervals.name: Upper trap stretch – right
intervals.comment: Ear to shoulder, opposite hand reaching down.

intervals.name: Levator stretch – left
intervals.comment: Nose toward armpit.

intervals.name: Levator stretch – right
intervals.comment: Nose toward armpit.

timers.name: Hangboard: max hangs and repeaters
timers.description: Warm-up hangs, max hangs (5 × 10 s, 3 min rest), then repeaters (3 sets of 6 × 7 s on / 3 s off). About 40 min.

intervals.name: Warm up
intervals.comment: Raise the pulse, arm circles, scapular pulls, easy climbing or band pulls.

intervals.name: Warm-up hang
intervals.comment: Big edge, feet on a chair. About 50% effort.

intervals.name: Warm-up hang
intervals.comment: Max hang edge, some weight off. About 70% effort.

intervals.name: Warm-up hang
intervals.comment: Max hang edge, bodyweight. About 85% effort.

intervals.name: Rest
intervals.comment: Set the load for the max hangs.

intervals.name: Max hang
intervals.comment: 20 mm edge, half crimp, shoulders engaged. A load you could hold for about 13 s.

intervals.name: Rest
intervals.comment: Full rest: shake out, chalk up. Drop the load if a hang fails early.

intervals.name: Repeater hang
intervals.comment: Same edge, bodyweight or a little off. Smooth on and off, no kipping.

intervals.name: Cool down
intervals.comment: Forearm flexor and extensor stretches, wrist circles, open-hand shakes.

timers.name: No-hangs: one hand at a time
timers.description: Lifting from an edge block or loading pin, left and right separately: max pulls (6 × 10 s), then repeaters (3 sets of 6 × 7/3 s). About 40 min.

intervals.name: Warm up
intervals.comment: Raise the pulse, arm circles, scapular pulls, light band pulls.

intervals.name: Left – warm-up pull
intervals.comment: Light, then heavier each round: about 50%, 70%, 85%.

intervals.name: Right – warm-up pull
intervals.comment: Light, then heavier each round: about 50%, 70%, 85%.

intervals.name: Rest
intervals.comment: Set the weight for the max pulls.

intervals.name: Left – max pull
intervals.comment: 20 mm edge, half crimp, arm straight, shoulder engaged. Lift smoothly, no jerk.

intervals.name: Right – max pull
intervals.comment: 20 mm edge, half crimp, arm straight, shoulder engaged. Lift smoothly, no jerk.

intervals.name: Rest
intervals.comment: Each hand rests about 2 min between pulls.

intervals.name: Rest
intervals.comment: Lighten the weight for repeaters: about 60–70% of the max pull.

intervals.name: Left – pull
intervals.comment: Lift, hold, set down. Same grip on every rep.

intervals.name: Right – pull
intervals.comment: Lift, hold, set down. Same grip on every rep.

intervals.name: Cool down
intervals.comment: Forearm flexor and extensor stretches, wrist circles, open-hand shakes.
